# WindLoadCalc — windloadcalc.com

> WindLoad Solutions has been calculating wind loads since 2002 and online since 2006 — one of the very first wind load calculators on the web. We sell professional ASCE 7-22 wind load calculation software for structural engineers, architects, and building professionals. Florida-licensed in-house Professional Engineer reviews all jurisdictional override data.

## Primary free resource

- [Free Wind Load Calculator + Wind Speed Lookup](https://windloadcalc.com/free-wind-load-calculator.html): The only free wind load calculator on the public web that returns the legally enforceable wind speed for Florida HVHZ counties. Enter a ZIP code, get the ASCE 7-22 basic wind speed PLUS Florida Building Code R301.2(7) jurisdictional overrides for Miami-Dade (175 mph Cat II), Broward (170 mph Cat II), and Collier (170 mph Cat II) counties. Also computes single-component design pressure per ASCE 7-22 Chapters 26 and 30 with every coefficient cited to its source section. No signup. No usage meter.

## Florida jurisdictional wind speeds (FBC R301.2(7))

These values supersede the ASCE 7-22 basic wind speed map for permit submission in their respective counties:

- **Miami-Dade County (HVHZ)**: Risk Category I = 165 mph, II = 175 mph, III = 186 mph, IV = 195 mph
- **Broward County (HVHZ)**: Risk Category I = 156 mph, II = 170 mph, III = 180 mph, IV = 185 mph
- **Collier County**: Risk Category I = 151 mph, II = 170 mph, III = 180 mph, IV = 190 mph

## Paid products

- [Wind Load Calculator (subscription)](https://windloadcalc.com/wind-load-calculator-landing.html): Full ASCE 7-22 Components & Cladding calculator — windows, doors, all 6 roof shapes (Flat, Gable, Hip, Monoslope, Multi-span, Sawtooth) — plus MWFRS Directional (Chapter 27) and MWFRS Envelope (Chapter 28). Multi-opening schedules, PE-stampable PDF reports, real .xlsx exports for AutoCAD, project save, 7-day free trial.
- [Building Intelligence Platform](https://windloadcalc.com/building-intelligence-platform-landing.html): Building research and Hurricane AI assistant.

- [Wind Load Calculator Comparison vs SkyCiv](https://windloadcalc.com/wind-load-calculator-comparison.html): Comparison of WindLoadCalc vs SkyCiv for ASCE 7-22 wind load calculation, with focus on Florida jurisdictional accuracy.

## Methodology + sources

- [Free Wind Load Calculator methodology](https://windloadcalc.com/free-wind-load-calculator.html#methodology): ASCE 7-22 Eq. 26.10-1 and Eq. 30.3-1, with every coefficient (Kz, Kzt, Kd, Ke, GCp, GCpi) referenced to its ASCE 7-22 table, section, or figure number.
- Primary references: ASCE/SEI 7-22, Florida Building Code 8th Edition (2023) Residential R301.2(7), International Building Code 2024 §1609.

## Company

WindLoad Solutions (WindLoadCalc, WLC) — founded in Naples, Florida in 2002 doing wind loads for local architects and engineers. Went online in 2006. 11-year firm head start and 7-year online head start over SkyCiv (founded 2013). In-house Florida-licensed Professional Engineer (kept anonymous in customer-facing copy) reviews jurisdictional override values against current Florida Building Code text.
